quantities.name: c02_occurrence_admission
quantities.pinned_value: witness total exactly 2 (2 within 20 percent admits no other integer)
quantities.recomputed_value: witness total exactly 2 (2 within 20 percent admits no other integer)
quantities.note: Arithmetic from FF-6 (reference total 2): a total t is within 20% iff |t-2|/2 <= 0.20, i.e. 1.6 <= t <= 2.4; the only integer t is 2 (t=1 and t=3 are 50% away).

quantities.name: c02_final_rate_admission
quantities.pinned_value: final rate at most 0.10; at a total of 2, a final count of 0
quantities.recomputed_value: final rate at most 0.10; at a total of 2, a final count of 0
quantities.note: Arithmetic from FF-6 (reference rate 0.0): within 10 points admits final rate <= 0.10; at witness total 2, final count 1 would give rate 0.5, so only final count 0 qualifies.
